title: Grateful Dead Live at Sam Boyd Silver Bowl, U.N.L.V. on 1993-05-16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy May 16 1993 Vegas show, highlighted by a stellar Help→Slip→Franklin’s sequence and a monster Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording is a crisp soundboard source that showcases the band at peak late‑90s form – Jerry’s tone is front‑and‑center, Vince’s keyboards sparkle, and the mix is generally superb.  While Bob’s voice shows signs of strain and the first set is often called “throwaway,” the second set delivers fireworks with Help > Slip > Franklin’s, The Other One, Althea, Row Jimmy and a soaring Terrapin jam.  Overall the show feels electric and memorable.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating across 25 reviews is 4.28; most comments praise both performance and recording, with only a few low‑star outliers.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, front‑center mix with Jerry’s guitar tone prominent; noted as the last Healy broadcast. A few reviewers mention slight bass distortion or minor drop‑outs, but overall clarity and balance are outstanding.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A very short first set that many call throwaway, followed by a second set that builds momentum with a classic H>S>F sequence, extended jams and high energy peaks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as in the best mood ever, doing a 360 spin, grinning, delivering powerful solos and an upfront tone; many say "Jerry is ON" and his playing carries the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Generally praised for being present and solid in the mix (though one reviewer notes slight bass distortion); noted for tight interplay on Row Jimmy.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal problems are a recurring theme – flubbed lyrics, ragged/shot voice – but reviewers still commend his effort and occasional emotional impact.
band_member_comments.Keys: Vince’s keyboard work receives high praise (especially on Slipknot, Althea, Row Jimmy, and the spacey Elvis‑style sections); a few call his “toy piano” moments odd, yet overall his contributions are seen as a highlight.
